I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

An allotment of land in extent of about 0.0290 Hecatre, depictedas Lot ‘A’ in the Advance Tracing No. MR/MLT/2016/349 dated21.11.2016, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Villageof Ransagoda (F.V.P. 97) in the Minor Division of Kandabadapattuwain the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mulatiyana in MataraDistrict, Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Ransagoda ancient temple premises aliasMuththettu Idama– Extent: 0.0290 HectareNorth and East: Ransagoda ancient temple premises aliasMuththettu Idama claimed by Ven. Gombaddala Manirathana Thero;South: Ransagoda ancient temple premises alias Muththettu Idamaclaimed by Ven. Gombaddala Manirathana Thero and Way; West:Way and Ransagoda ancient temple premises alias Muththettu Idamaclaimed by Ven. Gombaddala Manirathana Thero.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
